spec.name: Captain Cardboard
spec.description: A stylized kid in a homemade cardboard-box robot costume: kraft box torso with a marker-drawn control panel, a box helmet with a taped visor window where the kid's face peeks out, an antenna, cardboard tube arms with mitts, cardboard boots, and a paper jetpack with zigzag paper flames on the back.
spec.layout: A kid about 1.3 m tall standing facing +Z, feet flat on y = 0, wearing a robot costume made of kraft cardboard boxes and duct tape. From front to back: the big cardboard torso box (0.74 wide x 0.58 tall x 0.50 deep, y 0.58-1.16) with its blue control panel, gauges, buttons and tape band on the front face; above it a 0.44 m cube cardboard helmet (y 1.14-1.58) with a taped visor window in its front face where the kid's real face peeks out - eyes, blush, fringe of hair, mouth - and a thin antenna with a red ball rising from the helmet top to y 1.86. Arms hang in a rest pose slightly out and forward: cardboard tubes from shoulder pads on the torso box down to round cardboard mitts at y ~0.73. Below the torso box the kid's own legs show: denim shorts, cardboard thigh guards with a bare-knee gap, red painted knee discs, shin guards, and chunky cardboard boots whose soles rest flat on the floor at [+-0.17, 0, ~0.15]. On the back, a smaller cardboard jetpack box with two toilet-roll nozzles and flat zigzag paper flames trailing down to y ~0.6. Every surface is kraft cardboard brown with lighter cut edges, corrugation fluting strips on vertical edges, duct-tape patches and straps, and marker-drawn gauges, buttons and stickers in crayon-bright flat colours.

parts.builds: The costume body: a big kraft-cardboard box worn round the kid's chest, 0.74 m wide x 0.58 m tall x 0.50 m deep spanning y 0.58-1.16, rigid on the body joint. Main box in `cardboard` with a `cardboardLight` rim strip along the bottom edge and thin vertical `fluting` strips (~8 half-round strips per edge) down the two front vertical corners to read as corrugated cardboard. Front face, all details seated 0.01 proud: a rounded control panel in `robotBlue` (0.30 x 0.22, centred [0, 0.92, 0.26]) with a `tape` border; on it a big gauge - a `panelWhite` disc 0.09 across with 12 tiny `ink` tick marks and an `ink` needle - plus a smaller `paintYellow` disc gauge beside it; two push-buttons below (a `robotRed` and a `paintGreen` cylinder, 0.025 across, 0.02 proud) and a small `paintGreen` switch lever. Below the panel a marker-drawn smiley: a `paintYellow` round sticker 0.10 across with two `ink` eye dots and an `ink` curve strip. A `tape` band 0.06 tall wrapping the box at y 0.66 with a `tapeDark` edge, a crossed tape 'X' repair patch at the lower front-right corner, and a few crayon squiggles as thin `robotRed` and `paintBlue` wavy strips flat on the lower front. Shoulder pads: quarter-disc cardboard pads (`cardboardLight`, 0.14 radius) on the box top corners at mounts shoulderL and shoulderR, each with a `bolt` stud on top. Collar: a `tape` ring 0.05 tall round the box top at mount collar, where the helmet sits. Side vents: three short `cardboardDark` slats low on each side. Bottom edge open with a short `cardboardDark` inner rim visible below the hips.
parts.attaches: Rides the body joint; its top edge meets the helmet at mount collar [0, 1.15, 0.02]; its shoulder pads sit on mounts shoulderL/shoulderR where the arm tubes root; its open bottom edge is above the legs part's shorts at mounts hipL/hipR; its back face is the surface the jetpack part presses against at mount backMount.

parts.builds: The costume head: a kraft-cardboard box helmet, 0.44 m cube centred [0, 1.36, 0.02] (y 1.14-1.58, z -0.20 to 0.24), rigid on the head joint; the kid's real face peeks through a visor window in the front face. Build the helmet as slabs, with the front face as four slabs around a window opening 0.26 wide x 0.17 tall centred [0, 1.385, 0.24]; frame the window with a `tape` border 0.02 wide. The kid's head inside: a rounded head sphere (`skin`, 0.105 radius) centred [0, 1.35, 0.06] riding the head joint, face turned to +Z; in the window show: two big eyes (each an `eyeWhite` disc 0.035 with an `iris` disc 0.02, an `ink` pupil 0.012 and a tiny white highlight dot), a `blush` disc 0.018 under each eye at its outer corner, a small `ink` nose dot, a fringe of `hair` tufts (5-6 small extruded triangular tufts) along the top of the window, and the mouth built as an upper lip strip on the head and a separate lower lip strip on the jaw joint at [0, 1.3, 0.1] so it can open. On the helmet: a thin antenna (0.008 rod, `bolt`) rising from the top at [0.10, 1.58, -0.02] to y 1.84 with a `robotRed` ball 0.035 on top; a crossed tape 'X' patch of two `tape` strips on the right side; a `paintYellow` round gauge sticker (0.06, `ink` needle) on the left side; two `bolt` studs on the sides; `cardboardLight` edge strips along the top edges and `fluting` strips down the front vertical edges; a small `hair` tuft poking out at the back bottom edge.
parts.attaches: Rides the head and jaw joints; its bottom edge meets the torso box top at mount collar [0, 1.15, 0.02]; its face sits inside the window so it reads from the front; nothing in front of the face.

parts.builds: Both costume arms: cardboard tubes in a rest pose hanging slightly out and forward. Upper arm: a tube (0.075 radius) from mount shoulderL [0.36, 1.13, 0] to elbow [0.52, 0.92, 0.07], and mirrored from shoulderR to [-0.52, 0.92, 0.07], riding the shoulder joints; forearm: a tube (0.065 radius) from each elbow to wrist [+-0.55, 0.73, 0.17] on the elbow joints. Each arm wears a `tape` ring 0.03 tall at the elbow seam, a `tape` cuff ring at the wrist, and a `bolt` stud on the shoulder cap at the mount. Mitts: rounded mitts on the wrist joints - a squashed sphere 0.095 in `cardboardLight` with a `cardboard` thumb nub on the inner side, a `cardboardDark` worn fingertip patch, and two short `ink` knuckle line strips. Details: a paper 'power meter' sticker on the left forearm (`paintYellow` rounded rect 0.07 x 0.05 with `ink` needle and tick marks), a `robotRed` painted stripe ring round the right upper arm, a `fluting` corrugation strip down the outer edge of each arm, and a small `tapeDark` repair patch on the right forearm.
parts.attaches: Tubes root at mounts shoulderL/shoulderR on the torso box's top corners, under its shoulder pads; they ride the shoulder, elbow and wrist joints; mitts hang free above the floor.

parts.builds: The kid's own legs in cardboard boots, from under the torso box down to the floor. Shorts: a `denim` band 0.12 tall round each thigh at y 0.50-0.62 under the box bottom edge, riding the hip joints at mounts hipL/hipR. Thigh guards: cardboard panels (0.10 wide, front and outer side) over each thigh from y 0.48 to the knee in `cardboard` with a `cardboardLight` edge strip; the knee shows through as a small bare `skin` patch 0.04 with a `robotRed` painted knee disc 0.055 riding the knee joints. Shin guards: cardboard slabs from knee to ankle with a `fluting` corrugation strip down the front of each. Boots: chunky cardboard boots on the foot joints - a box 0.13 wide x 0.14 tall x 0.22 long with a rounded `cardboardLight` toe cap, a `sole` slab 0.025 thick resting flat on the floor at y = 0 centred [+-0.17, 0, 0.15], a `tape` strap across the boot top with a small `bolt` buckle, and a `tapeDark` scuff patch on the toe. Feet point forward to z ~0.26.
parts.attaches: Rides the hip, knee and foot joints; the shorts tuck under the torso box's open bottom edge at mounts hipL/hipR; boot soles are the only parts touching the floor.

parts.builds: A homemade cardboard jetpack strapped to the torso box's back, rigid on the body joint at mount backMount [0, 0.95, -0.26]. Pack: a smaller kraft box 0.50 wide x 0.44 tall x 0.17 deep centred [0, 0.95, -0.36] (z -0.27 to -0.44) in `cardboard`, with a `tape` border round its top edge and a `cardboardLight` edge strip down its vertical edges. Back face: a `robotBlue` circle emblem 0.14 across with a `paintYellow` 5-point star on it and a thin `ink` outline ring, seated 0.01 proud. Nozzles: two toilet-roll nozzles (tubes 0.055 radius, 0.14 long) at the pack's bottom corners [+-0.16, 0.78, -0.38], angled down and outward, in `cardboardDark` with a `tape` ring where each meets the pack. Flames: flat paper cutout flames under each nozzle - an extruded zigzag flame 0.20 long in `paperOrange` pointing down-out with a smaller `paperYellow` flame inside it, trailing to y ~0.60, clearly paper, not fire. Two triangular fins (extruded, 0.14 tall, `cardboardLight`) at the pack's top sides, and two short `tape` strap loops on the pack's sides where it meets the torso box.
parts.attaches: Presses against the torso box's back face at mount backMount [0, 0.95, -0.26], fully behind the body box (z < -0.26) and behind the helmet's rear face; rides the body joint.
